column1: # Tree-sitter grammars for the code viewer, fetched by `just tree-sitter-grammars`
# into Vendor/TreeSitterGrammars (gitignored). One row per parser.
#   id        module suffix and directory name
#   ref       tag or commit (SQL's generated parser only exists on gh-pages)
#   dir       grammar directory inside the repo (holds src/)
#   queries   highlight query files, highest precedence first; `repo:path`
#             reads from another row's checkout (TypeScript inherits JavaScript)
# JavaScript and C stay on 0.23.x: TypeScript and C++ inherit their queries and
